sentences.text:
Sanjay Govind Khedekar 
 V/s.
 The State of Maharashtra 
 ----
 Mr.Mateen Shaikh for the Applicant.
 Mr.Y.M. Nakhwa, App for the Respondent-State.

----
 Coram : C.V. Bhadang, J.
 Date : 18th March 2020
 P.C.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. This is an application for suspension of sentence.
The applicant has been convicted on five different counts for the offence punishable under various provisions of the Prevention of Food Nilam Digitally signed by Nilam Kamble Adulteration Act.
Apart from the substantive sentence of Kamble Date: 2020.03.18 16:38:39 +0530 imprisonment of six months, the applicant has been sentenced to pay fine of Rs.1,000/- on each count.
The total fine of Rs.5,000/- is paid.
N.S. Kamble page 1 of 2 902-ia-1-2020 in revn-178-2020 3.

The substantive sentence of imprisonment is hereby suspended subject to the applicant furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount before the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Khed within three weeks from today.
